observations.title: Multiple unpinned GitHub Action references
observations.technical_explanation: The CI workflow contains six references to third-party GitHub Actions using mutable version specifiers (major-version tags or branch names) instead of immutable commit SHAs. observations.layman_explanation: Several steps in the automation pipeline use version numbers that could be changed later. Using exact commit IDs would prevent unexpected changes from the action maintainers.
observations.developer_action: Consider auditing each action reference and pinning to a commit SHA where possible, especially for actions that handle secrets or produce release artifacts.
